title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 1985 1986 1992 1994 Barbi Benton + 1 Bonus Magazine
descriptionText:
Description:
“Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines. Includes December 1985 Barbi Benton Christmas issue, September 1986 Marla Collins, June 1992 Playmate of the Year issue, and September 1994 Robin Givens. Pre-owned vintage condition with normal storage/handling wear. Please review photos carefully for exact condition. Sold as the exact four magazines pictured.”
